name: puzzle-snap
title: Puzzle Snap
description: Geometric pieces spin in from scattered positions and snap into a mark with sparks, then the wordmark slides out beside it. The mark is a fixed set of shapes; the wordmark is the text variable.
useWhen: You have a wordmark but no animated mark, and the sting should build a simple geometric mark for you.
The brand is friendly or modular, and pieces clicking together tell that story.
avoidWhen: Your real logo must appear exactly as designed: the mark here is a fixed set of shapes, so use orbit-lock or spotlight around your own logo.
The brand is calm or luxurious and the snapping reads as too toy-like.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Wordmark
variables.description: Wordmark that slides out beside the mark. Leave empty for the mark alone.

variables.label: Primary
variables.description: Fill of the quarter circle and the small square.
